title: Iikhuki kule sayithi
body: Sisebenzisa iikhuki eziyimfuneko ukuze le sayithi isebenze. Ngemvume yakho, sikwasebenzisa iikhuki zohlalutyo nezentengiso. Ungatshintsha ukhetho lwakho nangaliphi na ixesha.

descriptions.necessary: Ziyafuneka ukuze isayithi isebenze, umzekelo ukuze uhlale ungenile. Zihlala zivuliwe.
